introduction.title: A more <highlight>intelligent</highlight> future, powered by $IQ.
introduction.description: BrainDAO is the legal entity that launched $IQ. It governs the token, stewards its treasury, and operates HiIQ staking.

token.title: Governance, staking, and a <highlight>shared treasury.</highlight>
token.description: IQ is the governance and staking token of BrainDAO. Locking IQ produces HiIQ, which sets voting power, reward share, and how ecosystem fees flow back to holders.

markets.title: Where $IQ <highlight>trades and lives.</highlight>
markets.description: IQ is listed on major centralized exchanges and swappable on decentralized venues across every chain it is deployed on.

utility.title: What <highlight>$IQ does.</highlight>
utility.description: Three things happen when IQ is locked. Each one is decided by your HiIQ balance, which grows with the length of the lock.

governance.title: Governance
governance.description: Your HiIQ balance determines your voting power on IQ proposals. The longer you lock, the more say you have in how BrainDAO and its treasury are run.

staking.title: Staking rewards
staking.description: Stakers earn additional IQ in proportion to their HiIQ balance, rewarding long-term commitment to the protocol.

burn.title: Fee burn & redistribution
burn.description: A share of ecosystem platform fees paid in IQ is burned or redistributed to stakers, contributing to a deflationary supply model.

treasury.title: A treasury governed by <highlight>IQ stakers.</highlight>
treasury.description: BrainDAO holds the IQ treasury and reports on it openly. Stake IQ to vote on how it is used, or open the dashboard to monitor it in real time.

chart.label: Supply locked in HiIQ
chart.foot: On-chain figures, read live from Ethereum

ecosystem.title: Built on <highlight>$IQ.</highlight>
ecosystem.description: The products that use the IQ token, run by teams across the ecosystem BrainDAO governs.

iqai.name: IQ AI
iqai.description: Tokenized AI agents and the infrastructure behind them.

wiki.name: IQ.wiki
wiki.description: The blockchain and crypto encyclopedia, with edits recorded on-chain.

dashboard.name: IQ Dashboard
dashboard.description: Stake IQ, bridge across chains, vote on proposals, and track the treasury.

meta.title: HiIQ - Stake IQ for governance power and rewards
meta.description: HiIQ is the staking mechanism for the IQ token. Lock IQ for up to four years to increase your voting power and earn staking rewards.

hiiq.title: HiIQ
hiiq.description: HiIQ is the staking mechanism for IQ. Locking IQ grants HiIQ, which determines your governance voting power and your share of staking rewards.

what.title: What HiIQ is
what.description: HiIQ is the staking mechanism for the IQ token. When you lock IQ you receive HiIQ, an account-based measure of your locked position that sets both your governance voting power and your share of rewards.

how.title: How it works
how.description: Lock IQ for up to four years to receive up to 4x HiIQ, following a veCRV-style model. The longer the lock, the higher the resulting HiIQ balance for the same amount of IQ.

non-transferable.title: Non-transferable
non-transferable.description: HiIQ does not trade on any market and cannot be transferred. It is an account-based measure of how long your IQ remains locked, not a tradeable asset.

decay.title: Decay
decay.description: Your HiIQ balance decreases linearly as the lock approaches expiry, reaching a 1:1 ratio with your locked IQ when no time remains. Extending a lock restores the multiplier.

rewards.title: Rewards
rewards.description: Stakers earn additional IQ in proportion to their HiIQ balance. A share of ecosystem fees paid in IQ may also be burned or redistributed to stakers, making the supply model deflationary.

requirements.title: Requirements
requirements.description: Your IQ must be on Ethereum to stake, and you need ETH in your wallet to cover gas for locking, extending, and claiming rewards.

newsletter.description: Occasional updates on IQ, HiIQ, and BrainDAO governance.

about.text: BrainDAO is creating an intelligent future as the governing DAO behind the IQ ecosystem, supported by <link>BrainFund</link>.
